radiology_report:
Amsterdam UMC, Campus AMC — Prostate mpMRI | 02 January 2025
Clinical context: Elevated PSA 9.6 ng/mL, prior biopsy bucket "Negative".

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume measures 30.0 mL. T2-weighted sequences disclose a 12×10 mm focus in the right mid-gland peripheral zone. Diffusion-weighted imaging demonstrates restricted diffusion with correspondingly low apparent diffusion coefficient values. Dynamic contrast-enhanced phases reveal early focal enhancement. No extraprostatic extension, seminal vesicle invasion, or suspicious pelvic lymphadenopathy is observed.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 3 lesion in the right mid-gland peripheral zone. Prostate volume 30.0 mL yielding a PSA density of 0.32 ng/mL/mL. csPCa predicted probability 0.6599411.

previous_notes.text: Routine screening initially recorded a PSA of 4.2 ng/mL, which prompted a repeat assessment in August returning 5.5 ng/mL. Given the upward trajectory and the patient’s age, a urology referral was arranged for further evaluation. At that consultation, no acute urinary complaints were noted.
